finding.title: A date-only fee schedule silently reports zero commission

evidence.description: fees.as_of is required; all five monetary schedule fields are optional. Date/source metadata alone passes the input shape.
commissionUsd returns null only if the whole fees value is absent. Otherwise usd starts at0 and only provided monetary fields change it; date-only object returns0.
Only null commission emits not_modelled. Numeric0 becomes commission_bps0 and participates in the partial total.
Description promises missing inputs are not modelled and never assumed; a date is not a commission amount.

static_counterexample.source_predicted_result: commission_bps=0, no commission not_modelled disclosure. Other missing-account checks remain their documented skipped checks; this example does not assume complete financial coverage.

finding.requested_resolution: Refuse an empty monetary schedule or preserve commission as null/not_modelled until a monetary schedule field is explicitly supplied. Explicit commission_bps:0 remains a supplied zero. Preserve the existing intended case where an explicitly supplied sell-only charge costs0 on buys; do not require every optional fee field or silently fill unknowns. Add date-only versus explicitly-zero controls at the shared local/hosted contract boundary.
finding.test_source_gap: Existing named commission test covers absent schedule, nonzero rates, minimums and explicit sell-only charges. Existing MCP fee test covers stale/source-less numeric schedules and complete omission, without a date-only negative control.
scope_limits: Source semantics only; no module import/recompute/Node/runtime or measured financial result.
No actual live hosted request; hosted source reuses this input/core.
Historical source deliveries/receipts unchanged; primary may adjudicate in an isolated correction scope.
